title: Message of the day
description: The GalaxaHub message of the day tab.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Message of the day tab on lab start when the hub has entries or notifications for you.

reopenOnBroadcast.title: Reopen on a live broadcast
reopenOnBroadcast.description: Reopen the tab when a broadcast from the hub arrives while the lab is open.

pollMinutes.title: Pull interval in minutes
pollMinutes.description: Pull the message of the day again on this interval while the tab is open. 0 never pulls again.
